mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM fee_type WHERE fee_type_id=#{feeTypeId} AND status='ACTIVE')

SELECT r.person_id, pu.property_unit_id, pu.property_no, c.community_name, b.building_no, v.bill_id, v.bill_no, v.status AS bill_status, v.outstanding_amount AS bill_outstanding_amount, ft.fee_type_id, ft.fee_code, ft.fee_name, bi.amount AS item_amount FROM residence r JOIN property_unit pu ON pu.property_unit_id=r.property_unit_id JOIN building_unit bu ON bu.building_unit_id=pu.building_unit_id JOIN building b ON b.building_id=bu.building_id JOIN community c ON c.community_id=b.community_id JOIN v_bill_financial_summary v ON v.property_unit_id=pu.property_unit_id JOIN bill_item bi ON bi.bill_id=v.bill_id JOIN fee_standard fs ON fs.fee_standard_id=bi.fee_standard_id JOIN fee_type ft ON ft.fee_type_id=fs.fee_type_id WHERE r.end_date IS NULL AND r.person_id IN #{personId} AND v.due_date <= CURRENT_DATE AND v.outstanding_amount > 0 AND v.status IN ('ISSUED','PARTIALLY_PAID','OVERDUE') AND b.community_id IN #{communityId} AND 1=0 ORDER BY r.person_id, v.bill_id, bi.item_no
